text: Cloud computing means using computers and services over the internet. Users can use cloud services without keeping everything on their own computer.
Cloud security protects data and applications stored in the cloud. Cloud providers use security methods such as access controls and encryption.
Cloud storage allows users to save files online. Users can access their files from different devices using the internet.
Serverless computing allows developers to run code without managing servers. The cloud provider manages the servers for them.
A virtual machine is a computer created using software. It can work like a normal computer but runs on another physical computer.
